description: Make an incoming webhook: a URL a third party (Twitch, a payment provider, n8n…) calls with a JSON body, and Neblla hands that body to a room — its server file hears neblla.room.on("hook", ({ name, data }) => …) on the Fogs — or, with to: "user", to the user named in the call (?user=<their id in the app>). The URL carries a token shown only now; making it again with the same name gives a new token (the old URL stops working). Up to 20 per app; 64 KB per call; 60 calls a minute per hook. Answers: 200 { delivered }, 404 hook_not_found, 409 room_not_live / user_not_online. No server of yours needed.

name.description: Hook name: a letter, then letters, digits, _ or - (≤ 40)

to.description: Who gets it: a room (its server file) or the user named in each call

name: neblla_create_hook
